name: Cadenza
description: The soloist off the leash: a cascade of heads running clean off the top of the stave.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @pick(4%, 24%, 44%, 64%); top: @pick(4%, 24%, 44%, 64%); width: 32%; height: 32%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 82%; width: 100%; height: 7%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
